reconfigure.title: Reconfigure SpoolTap
reconfigure.description: Point SpoolTap at a new Bambuddy URL (for example after moving Bambuddy to another host). Your slot tags and dashboard are kept.

data.api_token: API key (optional — required only if Bambuddy authentication is on)

error.cannot_connect: Cannot connect to Bambuddy at that URL.
error.invalid_auth: Bambuddy rejected the request (401/403). Its authentication is on: enter an API key with the 'can_read_status' and 'can_manage_inventory' scopes.

abort.reconfigure_successful: SpoolTap now points at the new Bambuddy URL.
